intro: The church is more than a Sunday service. Week after week, MFM Edinburgh is a place of prayer, care and welcome for Leith and the wider city, for members, neighbours, students, families and newcomers alike.

areas.title: A house of prayer for the city
areas.text: Our doors open on Tuesday and Friday evenings as well as Sunday, so anyone carrying a burden has somewhere to bring it. Mountain Moving Prayers, the Spiritual Clinic and intercessory prayer cover our families, our neighbours and Edinburgh itself.
points: Tuesday Spiritual Clinic, prayer and Bible study
Prayer and counsel by phone, any day
areas.alt: The whole church standing during Mountain Moving Prayers

areas.title: Children and young people
areas.text: Young people lead prayer, sing in the choir and speak from the lectern. Children have their own place in the life of the church, and every Christmas they are celebrated at the Love Feast.
points: Young members leading prayer and worship
Christmas Love Feast with a gift for every child
areas.alt: Young members of the choir singing with the band

areas.title: A welcome for neighbours and newcomers
areas.text: Students, families and workers arriving in Scotland find a church family here. Friends from the wider Edinburgh community regularly join our services and programmes, and sit side by side with our members.
points: Guests from local churches and the community
A church family for people far from home
areas.alt: Guests and members standing together in prayer

areas.title: Care for families
areas.text: We celebrate with families in their joys and stand with them in hard times: visiting the sick and housebound, supporting the bereaved, and pointing people to trusted local help when money is tight.
points: Help reaching food banks and crisis grants
areas.alt: A family and friends gathered in matching blue for a celebration

areas.title: Music that lifts the city
areas.text: Our choir and musicians serve every service and open their concerts to everyone, including the Unrelenting Hallelujah choir concert and our Joyful Noise celebrations.
points: Services shared on YouTube for those who can’t attend
areas.alt: The choir leading the church at the Joyful Noise concert
